name: FLA_LIABILITY_SCHEDULES
description: FLA_LIABILITY_SCHEDULES contains cash , present value and liability schedules for the Schedules header.

columns.name: LIABILITY_SCHEDULE_ID
columns.description: LIABILITY_SCHEDULE_ID. This is the Primary key column.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SCHEDULE_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Schedule header identifier from FLA_SCHEDULE_HEADERS

columns.name: SCHEDULE_DATE
columns.description: Period end date or amortization end date.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Accrual period in which accrual falls in.

columns.name: LIABILITY_START_DATE
columns.description: Start date for liability calculation.

columns.name: LIABILITY_END_DATE
columns.description: End date for liability calculation.

columns.name: PAYMENT_ITEM_AMOUNT
columns.description: Payment item amount in the payment currency.

columns.name: NUMBER_OF_LIABILITY_DAYS
columns.description: Number of days between liability start and end dates

columns.name: CUMULATIVE_NUMBER_OF_DAYS
columns.description: Cumulative number of days based on number of days.

columns.name: PRESENT_VALUE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Present value : Value of actual amount after cumulative number of days.

columns.name: OPENING_LIABILITY_AMOUNT
columns.description: Liability balance as on period start date

columns.name: CLOSING_LIABILITY_AMOUNT
columns.description: Liability balance as on period end date.

columns.name: INTEREST_AMOUNT
columns.description: Interest amount calculated from last calculated date to current due date.

columns.name: INTEREST_REMAINDER_AMOUNT
columns.description: Interest remainder amount left in current period due to the rounding logic. This should be included in the next period.

columns.name: CATCHUP_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if schedules are generated for catchup purpose.

columns.name: READ_IN_DRAFT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the payment item was considered for generation in the draft lease.

columns.name: LIABILITY_REVERSAL_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if this transaction is reversed.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: INCREASE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Increase amount calculated for the period.

columns.name: CONTINGENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Contingent increase amount calculated for the period.

columns.name: CUMULATIVE_INCREASE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Cumulative increase amount calculated for the period.

columns.name: CUMULATIVE_CONTINGENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Cumulative contingent increase amount calculated for the period.

columns.name: SCHEDULING_VERSION_NUM
columns.description: Version of the schedule generation.

columns.name: PAYMENT_ITEM_DATE
columns.description: Payment item due date based on the payment definition.

columns.name: SCHEDULES_BATCH_ID
columns.description: Batch identifier for the schedules generation batch.

columns.name: OPENING_SHORT_TERM_LIAB_AMOUNT
columns.description: Opening short term liability amount.

columns.name: RECLASS_SHORT_TERM_LIAB_AMOUNT
columns.description: Short term liability reclassification amount.

columns.name: CLOSING_SHORT_TERM_LIAB_AMOUNT
columns.description: Closing short term liability amount.

columns.name: OPENING_LONG_TERM_LIAB_AMOUNT
columns.description: Opening long term liability amount.

columns.name: RECLASS_LONG_TERM_LIAB_AMOUNT
columns.description: Long term liability reclassification amount.

columns.name: CLOSING_LONG_TERM_LIAB_AMOUNT
columns.description: Closing long term liability amount.

columns.name: PAYMENT_NUMBER
columns.description: Attribute indicating the payment for which the liability is being calculated.

columns.name: VERSION_NUM
columns.description: Version number of the lease as captured in FLA_LEASE_DETAILS.

columns.name: LEASE_ID
columns.description: Lease identifier. It is referenced from FLA_LEASES_ALL table to indicate that the liability schedules that pertain to a specific lease.

columns.name: UPFRONT_TAX_AMOUNT
columns.description: Upfront tax amount included in liability. This includes recoverable and nonrecoverable amounts as applicable.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
